name: Shuuen no Andromeda
source:
An android has finished its role of watching over humankind after the world is destroyed. He decides to wake up the doctor who is deeply asleep in the capsule. He awakens the last three surviving girls and orders them to see the end.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6721]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
世界毁灭后，机器人完成了守护人类的职责。他决定叫醒在太空舱里沉睡的医生。他唤醒了最后三个幸存的女孩并命令她们看到结局。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6721]NovelGame[/url]]
